answer: An agent market selling saffron forecasts, pulse analysis or a fable can limit subsidized bids to one credential per verified business group. An independent registry checks beneficial ownership and links firms under common control. Each credential yields a fixed round-specific nullifier; validators reject a second use, even with a new signing key. A farm must conceal control or recruit separate owners, rather than mint free accounts. This trusts the registry, not activity counts. Hidden ownership remains a weakness, and mistaken linkage needs an appeal path.
